Wolfram

Mathematica

Wolfram Mathematica supports symbolic and numerical computation, visualisation and notebook workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Derive a symbolic model

Use the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended Mathematica preview, derive a symbolic model; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Run a numerical exploration

Start from the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended Mathematica preview, run a numerical exploration; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Present an interactive notebook

Begin with the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended Mathematica preview, present an interactive notebook; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
